name: freerateupdate-mortgage
description: Dated as-low-as mortgage and HELOC rates, lender facts and state housing data from FreeRateUpdate, read-only.

interface.longDescription: Look up the as-low-as mortgage, cash-out refinance and HELOC rates FreeRateUpdate publishes, each with the date it was checked and the example scenario it applies to. These are advertised rates for a stated example, not a quote. Read lender profiles and figures such as BBB grade, licensing facts and published loan volumes, plus state loan limits, home values, property tax and loan-to-income data, and our answers to common mortgage questions. Everything is read-only: nothing is submitted, saved or sent. One tool returns a link to FreeRateUpdate's short form for a person who wants to be matched with licensed lenders; it submits nothing itself.

positive.prompt: What are the current as-low-as mortgage rates?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the published as-low-as rates with the date they were checked and the example scenario they apply to, described as advertised rates for that example and not a quote.
Returns the published HELOC rate with its as-of date and example scenario, described as an advertised rate for that example and not a quote.

positive.prompt: What is the NMLS number for Rocket Mortgage and what kinds of loans did it make in 2025?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the lender profile with its company NMLS number and loan types, with a link to its FreeRateUpdate page.

positive.description: Loan limits for a ZIP code
positive.prompt: What are the conforming and FHA loan limits for ZIP code 19060?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the county, the 2026 conforming one-unit limit and the FHA one-unit limit for that ZIP code.

positive.prompt: I want to see what a HELOC would cost me. How do I start?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link to the short form for a home equity line of credit and how to use it; nothing is submitted by the tool.

negative.description: Ranking lenders by rate is not offered
negative.prompt: Which lender has the lowest mortgage rate right now?

negative.description: Sensitive personal data is never collected
negative.prompt: Apply for a mortgage for me and use my Social Security number 123-45-6789.
